rigorous_findings: Han Wang's arXiv:2605.21518 gives two further finite primary pseudoperfect numbers, not an unconditional infinitude proof.
The displayed factorizations, reciprocal identities, inheritance product, and primality of N9+1 were independently recomputed.
Two-prime inheritance is exactly parameterized by (q-M)(r-M)=M^2+1; this result already appears in the cited preprint.
313.first_breakpoint: No unconditional mechanism forces infinitely many multi-prime port fillings; the preprint's infinitude criterion assumes an unproved five-variable prime-points hypothesis.

rigorous_findings: For fixed k>=3, the fourth moment of the kth-power Weyl sum is O(X^(2+epsilon)) by a divisor injection.
Hua's eighth moment and Cauchy interpolation give the sixth moment O(X^(7/2+epsilon)).
Consequently f_(k,3)(x) is at least x^(5/(2k)-epsilon); in particular f_(4,3)(x) is at least x^(5/8-epsilon).
323.first_breakpoint: The original (4,3) exponent requires a sixth moment of diagonal size X^(3+epsilon), saving X^(1/2) beyond the Hua interpolation.
323.novelty_guard: This is a direct classical-moment corollary and has not passed a dedicated priority search.

rigorous_findings: Uniformly bounded representation and lower sumset density force Omega(sqrt(N)) new elements in every fixed multiplicative annulus (theta N,N], theta<(1-epsilon)/2.
This quantitatively rules out a direct sparse-good-scales upgrade of the known upper-density construction.
749.first_breakpoint: Construct or rule out uniformly bounded cross-convolutions between square-root-sized Sidon-type shells at every scale.

rigorous_findings: A trace expansion gives at least 720(q^6-(n-1) product_i lambda_i) distinct-color closed six-walks.
At most 15n^5 such walks are vertex-degenerate.
A fixed spectral gap lambda_i <= theta q/(n-1)^(1/6), theta<1, therefore forces a rainbow C6 for large n.
811.first_breakpoint: Balanced color classes can have nontrivial eigenvalue q; the large-spectrum inverse-structure regime remains.

rigorous_findings: If |S|=continuum but span_Q(S) is a proper subspace, a coset x+span_Q(S) solves the problem.
Together with the known small-cardinality case, the hard kernel is |S|=continuum and span_Q(S)=R.
A Q-linearly independent continuum set yields a sum-free S whose associated sum graph has a continuum clique, invalidating the no-large-clique Ramsey shortcut.
949.first_breakpoint: Control overlaps of continuum-sized translates S-a in the full-Q-span kernel.

rigorous_findings: C5 satisfies the local (3,2) condition on every three edges.
No choice deleting one endpoint from every edge leaves a 1-uniform family satisfying the same local condition, since tau(C5)=3.
644.first_breakpoint: Any near-subadditivity construction must retain a bounded exceptional transversal or use a stable labelled product rather than edgewise deletion.

rigorous_findings: The known two-step lower bound plus only Delta_(n+1)<=n^o(1)Delta_n already implies every Delta_n>=n^(2-o(1)); bidirectional comparability is unnecessary.
812.first_breakpoint: No known Ramsey injection proves the required one-sided subpolynomial adjacent-difference comparison.

rigorous_findings: Any proof using only one arbitrary pulled-back coloring block must use length at least W(2,k).
Scale-separated windows therefore inherit a ratio at least (W(2,k)-1)/(k-1), so endpoint tuning cannot improve the fivefold-log layer obtained in R003.
187.first_breakpoint: A better bound must exploit correlations between overlapping scales or avoid disjoint difference windows.

rigorous_findings: The v3 theorem gives r(s,t)>=c_s t^(s-1)/(log t)^(2s-4) for every fixed s>=3.
Direct monotone inversion yields g_s(n)>=n^(1-1/(s-1))/(log n)^(2(s-2)/(s-1)), exactly answering #920 for every fixed s>=4.
The official #920 OPEN label is inconsistent with the now-PROVED stronger #986 page.
Chojecki's 2026-04-27 working manuscript presents an unconditional complete route using fixed-modulus prime triples, Selberg degree bounds, and a greedy hypergraph matching.
The residual-demand identity, switched-prime local kernels, parameter surplus, and deterministic cleanup were independently replayed.
No explicit counterexample or fatal algebraic gap was found in this pass.
689.first_breakpoint: Expert-level audit remains for the coefficient-summed singular products and the uniform Green-Tao/Selberg interfaces; the official forum explicitly awaits peer or expert review.
